mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 4-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to weak corporate earnings, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1700 thousand units signals weak consumer demand and reduced corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1700 (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) over the past month signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month (t-test p > 0.05 over 4-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceed 350,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer demand and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 350000 (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 136,000 thousand persons, it signals robust labor market conditions and strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > 136000 (t-test p > 0.05 over 4-year rolling windows).
